title: Optimization of reduction kernel based on Triton compiler
selection_reason: Optimizes Triton compiler code generation for reduction kernels using warp-shuffle intra-warp processing and FP16 data packing, reducing shared-memory usage and improving parallel efficiency of operators used in training and inference.
